products.name: NordicGips Standard Wallboard 12.5mm
products.description: Standard non-combustible gypsum wallboard with paper-faced ivory lining for residential and commercial partition walls.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: NordicGips Standard Wallboard 12.5mm (EN 520 Type A, DIN 18180) is an all-purpose gypsum building board designed for internal non-loadbearing drywall partitions, suspended ceilings, and wall lining furrings.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Density is 680 kg/m³ with a unit weight of 8.5 kg/m². Features HRAK tapered round longitudinal edges for joint compound adhesion. Fire reaction rating is Euroclass A2-s1,d0.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Maximum permissible vertical stud spacing is 625mm for walls up to 3.0m height. Fasten using 25mm fine-thread drywall screws (TN 25) spaced at maximum 250mm intervals on walls and 170mm on ceilings. Requires standard Q1 to Q4 jointing compounds. Not suitable for wet rooms or continuous humidity above 70% RH.

products.name: AcoustiBloc Studio Soundboard 12.5mm
products.description: Ultra-dense modified gypsum core board formulated for critical sound attenuation in recording studios, home theaters, and luxury hotels.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: AcoustiBloc Studio Soundboard 12.5mm (EN 520 Type D, I) is a high-mass acoustic plasterboard formulated with a crystalline-modified gypsum core (1040 kg/m³) to dissipate sound waves through internal friction.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Single board achieves weighted sound reduction index Rw of 58 dB in double-stud wall assemblies with 50mm stone wool cavity insulation. Surface hardness complies with Brinell Class I. Fire rating: A2-s1,d0.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Must be installed with staggered board joints between inner and outer layers. Maximum stud spacing is 600mm. Requires high-torque screws (e.g. ProFix TB or hardened TN screws) due to high core density. All perimeter interfaces must be sealed with non-hardening acoustic flanking mastic.

products.name: PyroSafe Structural Fireboard EI90 15mm
products.description: Heavy mineral-reinforced fire protection board incorporating vermiculite and glass fiber roving to resist structural burn-through for 90 minutes.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: PyroSafe Structural Fireboard EI90 15mm (EN 520 Type F) contains bonded glass fiber roving and vermiculite mineral grains that release chemically bound water when exposed to high heat, maintaining partition integrity in building fires.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Certified for EI 90 and EI 120 fire barriers according to EN 1364-1 and DIN 4102-4. Core density: 890 kg/m³, unit weight: 13.35 kg/m². Thermal shrinkage at 600°C is under 1.2%.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Recommended for emergency egress stairwells, elevator shaft enclosures, and plant rooms. Joints must be backed by steel studs or horizontal nogging straps and sealed with intumescent firestop compound. Screw spacing must not exceed 200mm.

products.name: HydroBloc WetRoom Board H1 12.5mm
products.description: Hydrophobic silicone-treated gypsum board with fungicides to inhibit mold and mildew growth in high-humidity commercial bathrooms.

data.water_absorption_class: EN 520 Type H1 (<5% total water absorption)
data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: HydroBloc WetRoom Board H1 12.5mm is a moisture-resistant gypsum wallboard with a hydrophobized core formulated with silicone oil additives to restrict water absorption below 5% by weight (Class H1).
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Surface water absorption is less than 120 g/m² after 2 hours immersion. Supports direct ceramic tile adhesion up to 32 kg/m² when primed. Treated with fungistatic agents to eliminate fungal sporulation.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Must be fastened using corrosion-resistant phosphated or coated screws (Class C5 or coated TN). Use green hydrophobic joint compound for seams. In direct water spray splash zones (showers), a liquid tanking waterproofing membrane must be applied prior to tiling.

products.name: Knauf Diamant Multi-Performance Board 12.5mm
products.description: Engineered premium gypsum board combining acoustic dampening, fire resistance, moisture protection, and extreme surface hardness.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: Knauf Diamant 12.5mm is a multi-performance board certified under EN 520 Type DFH2IR, delivering sound isolation (D), fire safety (F), moisture protection (H2), high impact resistance (I), and increased flexural strength (R).
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Density: 1050 kg/m³. Surface Brinell hardness: 38 N/mm². Provides up to 65 kg single-point cantilever load capacity using hollow wall metal anchors. Achieves up to Rw 62 dB acoustic rating in dual-stud partitions.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Requires specialized hardened Knauf Diamantschraube screws for installation due to high board density. Compatible with Knauf W112 and W115 partition systems. Recommended for hospital corridors, schools, and heavy commercial applications.

products.name: CemArmor Inorganic Portland Cement Board 12.5mm
products.description: 100% moisture-impervious Portland cement core board reinforced with alkali-resistant glass mesh for indoor swimming pools and exterior soffits.

data.core_composition: Hydraulic Portland Cement with Perlite Aggregate
data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: CemArmor Portland Cement Board 12.5mm is an inorganic, cementitious substrate engineered for continuous wet and high-stress environments such as commercial swimming pools, steam saunas, and exterior eaves.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Core is hydraulic Portland cement wrapped in alkali-resistant glass fiber mesh. Zero swelling or structural degradation under water immersion. Rated Euroclass A1 non-combustible. Maximum tile load capacity is 55 kg/m².
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Must be mounted on corrosion-protected steel framing (min. Z275 zinc coating or C3/C5 corrosion class). Fasten with stainless steel or ceramic-coated cement board screws. Jointing requires alkali-resistant fiberglass tape embedded in cementitious adhesive mortar.

products.name: CurvForm Flexible Gypsum Board 6.5mm
products.description: Ultra-thin fiberglass reinforced gypsum board engineered for tight architectural radiuses, barrel-vault ceilings, and curved wall designs.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: CurvForm Flexible Gypsum Board 6.5mm is an architectural board designed for creating curved walls, serpentine partitions, column casings, and arched barrel-vault ceilings.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Bends dry down to a 1000mm radius without pre-wetting. When moistened with a spiked roller and water spray, it achieves tight curves down to a 300mm radius. Weight: 4.6 kg/m².
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Substructure stud spacing must be reduced to 300mm or 150mm on curved framing sections. Double-layer installation (2 x 6.5mm) is recommended to achieve structural stiffness comparable to standard 12.5mm partitions.

products.name: AeroClean Perforated Acoustic Tile with Zeolite
products.description: Continuous acoustic perforated ceiling board backed with acoustic fleece and embedded with active zeolite minerals that decompose airborne VOCs.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: AeroClean Perforated Acoustic Ceiling Tile (EN 14190) combines room acoustic reverberation control with indoor air catalytic purification for open-plan offices, schools, and reception lobbies.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Achieves weighted sound absorption coefficient alpha_w of 0.85 (Class B). Gypsum matrix is enriched with natural zeolite crystals that permanently decompose airborne volatile organic compounds (VOCs).
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Must be installed with specialized alignment guides to keep perforation patterns continuous across joints. Fasten to CD 60/27 ceiling channels spaced at 333mm. Use jointing compound with precision foil cartridge applicator to prevent clogging perforations.

products.name: SilentCore Sub-Frequency Acoustic Slab 12.5mm
products.description: High-mass mineral core board optimized for structural decoupling of low-frequency subwoofer vibrations below 200 Hz.

data.composite_core: Heavy Barium-Gypsum Matrix with Viscoelastic Interlayer
data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: SilentCore Sub-Frequency Acoustic Slab 12.5mm is an ultra-dense board (1400 kg/m³) designed specifically to overcome resonance dips in low-frequency ranges (50 Hz to 200 Hz) where standard drywall fails.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Unit mass is 17.5 kg/m². Delivers total wall sound reduction index up to Rw 67–71 dB when applied as outer skin in multi-layer staggered drywall assemblies with resilient acoustic channels.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Requires heavy-duty structural stud framing (minimum 0.6mm steel gauge) to support board deadweight. Use hardened self-drilling screws spaced at 200mm. Never screw directly into floor without resilient acoustic perimeter tape.

products.name: StrukturMass Single-Layer High Load Board 20mm
products.description: 20mm extra-thick board designed for single-layer installation with certified EI 60 fire rating and heavy mechanical fixing loads.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: StrukturMass 20mm is an extra-thick single-layer drywall panel engineered to replace multi-layer double-board assemblies in commercial partitions.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Delivers certified EI 60 fire rating and 49 dB acoustic attenuation with only 1 layer per side. Reduces installation labor hours by 40% compared to dual 12.5mm boards.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Board width is standardized at 625mm for ergonomic manual handling on construction sites. Fasten using 35mm drywall screws (TN 35).

products.name: MedShield Barium Lead-Free X-Ray Board 12.5mm
products.description: Barium sulfate enriched radiation protection board providing 100% lead-free X-ray shielding for dental clinics and diagnostic radiology rooms.

data.core_composition: Barium Sulfate Gypsum Heavy Matrix (65% BaSO4)
data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: MedShield Barium X-Ray Board 12.5mm is a non-toxic, lead-free radiation barrier plasterboard engineered for hospital diagnostic suites, veterinary clinics, and dental radiography suites.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Density: 1600 kg/m³. A single layer provides 1.0mm Pb lead-equivalent shielding for X-ray tube voltages up to 100 kV according to DIN 6812. Eliminates toxic lead sheeting disposal hazards.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: All board joints must be backed by lead-free radiation sealing compound (MedShield Joint Paste) to prevent radiation leak pathways. Fasteners must be covered with radiation protection caps.

products.name: VulkanRock Acoustic Stone Wool Cavity Slab 50mm
products.description: Non-combustible stone wool slab engineered with an optimum airflow resistivity of 10 kPa·s/m² for drywall sound dampening.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: VulkanRock Acoustic Stone Wool Slab 50mm (Lambda 0.035 W/mK) is an inorganic stone wool batt engineered for sound absorption and fire compartmentation in drywall cavities.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Airflow resistivity is certified at 10 kPa·s/m² according to EN 29053, which is the exact acoustic optimum to prevent resonant standing waves in hollow studs without causing flanking transmission. Euroclass A1 non-combustible (melting point >1050°C).
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Friction-fits between vertical CW studs (625mm centers) without mechanical fasteners or slump over time. Maintain minimum 80% cavity fill depth for optimal acoustic rating.

products.name: VulkanRock Acoustic Stone Wool Cavity Slab 75mm
products.description: 75mm stone wool batts sized for friction-fit installation within CW 75 metal partition framing.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: VulkanRock 75mm Stone Wool Batt provides enhanced thermal and acoustic performance for 100mm–125mm total partition assemblies built on CW 75 metal substructures.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Thermal resistance R-value is 2.14 m²K/W. Airflow resistivity: 12 kPa·s/m². Certified non-combustible A1.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Install with snug edge contact to avoid thermal bridging gaps. Cut with a wavy-edge insulation knife.

products.name: VulkanRock Heavy Density Acoustic Batt 100mm
products.description: High-density 100mm stone wool batt for CW 100 partitions requiring maximum thermal barrier and low-frequency airborne sound isolation.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: VulkanRock Heavy 100mm is a high-density acoustic stone wool slab (40 kg/m³) engineered for inter-tenancy party walls and high acoustic isolation partitions.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Thermal resistance: R = 2.85 m²K/W. Airflow resistivity: 15 kPa·s/m². Provides structural fire insulation integrity up to EI 120 in double-stud drywall assemblies.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Fits inside CW 100 metal profiles or staggered double-stud drywall cavities. Ensure no compression occurs during board installation.

products.name: AlpineBio Carbon-Negative Wood Fiber Batts 60mm
products.description: Natural wood-fiber insulation batts made from sustainable sawmill residues, offering thermal phase shift to buffer summer heat.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: AlpineBio Wood Fiber Batts 60mm (EN 13171) are natural, carbon-negative ecological insulation panels manufactured from certified softwood residues with zero petrochemical binders.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Thermal conductivity: 0.038 W/mK. Specific heat capacity is 2100 J/kg·K (over double that of mineral wool), delivering high thermal phase shift to protect interiors against summer heatwaves. Absorbs and releases moisture without loss of thermal insulation power.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Friction-fit into timber studs or CW steel profiles. Avoid direct contact with liquid water; requires vapor-permeable membrane on the warm interior side.

products.name: IsoTherm Rigid Foil-Faced PIR Board 50mm
products.description: Ultra-efficient rigid polyisocyanurate (PIR) core board with gas-tight multi-layer aluminium facings for tight envelope insulation.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: IsoTherm Rigid PIR Board 50mm (EN 13165) provides ultra-low thermal conductivity (Lambda 0.022 W/mK), allowing minimum wall thickness while satisfying strict passive house building energy codes.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Thermal resistance: R = 2.27 m²K/W. Compressive strength at 10% deformation is 150 kPa. Aluminum foil facing serves as an integrated 100% vapor barrier (sd > 1500m).
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Board joints must be taped with pure aluminum sealing tape to maintain continuous vapor barrier integrity. Not flexible; requires flat structural masonry or framing substrates.

products.name: EcoFiber Pure Sheep Wool Thermal Roll 50mm
products.description: 100% natural washed sheep wool insulation roll with natural keratin fibers that absorb and neutralize airborne formaldehyde.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: EcoFiber Sheep Wool 50mm is a breathable, organic thermal insulation material that uses the natural chemistry of wool protein (keratin) to permanently bind and neutralize indoor chemical toxins.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Thermal conductivity: 0.036 W/mK. Can absorb up to 33% of its own weight in moisture without feeling damp or losing insulation value. Naturally flame-retardant (limiting oxygen index LOI 25%).
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Completely non-irritant to skin and respiratory tract; requires no PPE, gloves, or dust masks during cutting and installation.

products.name: NanoShield Aerogel Ultra-Thin Blanket 10mm
products.description: Nanoporous silica aerogel insulation blanket with the world's lowest thermal conductivity (0.015 W/mK) for eliminating cold thermal bridges.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: NanoShield Aerogel Blanket 10mm utilizes silica aerogel nanopores to achieve a thermal conductivity of 0.015 W/mK, delivering the thermal performance of 40mm conventional mineral wool in a 10mm space.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Eliminates thermal bridges around window reveals, balcony connections, and tight interior retrofits. Completely water-repellent (hydrophobic) yet vapor-permeable.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Cut using industrial shears or utility blades. Fasten with mechanical plastic washer anchors or specialized polyurethane contact adhesives.

products.name: StahlProfil CW 50 Partition Stud (3.0m)
products.description: Galvanized cold-rolled C-stud with embossed knurled flanges to prevent screw slip during high-speed drywall installation.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: StahlProfil CW 50 (3.0m, 0.6mm steel gauge) is the primary vertical structural framing element for slim drywall partitions with total wall thickness of 75mm or 100mm.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Cold-rolled from DX51D galvanized steel with 140 g/m² zinc coating. Flanges are embossed with diamond knurling to stop self-drilling screws from slipping during rapid mechanical fastening. Features H-shaped knockouts for electrical wires.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Slide vertically into UW 50 floor/ceiling tracks with 15mm clearance at the top to allow floor slab deflections. Standard vertical spacing: 625mm (or 417mm for heavy tile loads).

products.name: StahlProfil CW 75 Commercial Stud (3.0m)
products.description: 75mm wide vertical stud for high partition walls up to 4.5m with generous internal conduit capacity.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: StahlProfil CW 75 vertical stud is designed for commercial office partitions requiring wall heights up to 4.5 meters without structural reinforcement.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Moment of inertia: Iy = 7.45 cm⁴. Accommodates 75mm acoustic stone wool batts for enhanced acoustic ratings (Rw up to 58 dB in double-board setups).
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Insert into UW 75 perimeter tracks. Fix boards on both sides using staggered joint layouts.

products.name: StahlProfil CW 100 Heavy-Duty Vertical Stud (3.0m)
products.description: 100mm wide structural vertical stud for high partition walls up to 6.5m and maximum acoustic cavity separation.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: StahlProfil CW 100 is an extra-wide structural stud for industrial partitions, cinemas, and auditoriums reaching ceiling heights up to 6.5 meters.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Provides a 100mm internal acoustic cavity to hold thick 100mm stone wool slabs. Moment of inertia: Iy = 12.2 cm⁴.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Pairs with UW 100 floor and ceiling perimeter tracks. Stagger board joints.

products.name: StahlProfil UW 50 Floor & Ceiling Track (3.0m)
products.description: U-shaped perimeter track for anchoring CW 50 studs securely to floor and ceiling concrete slabs.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: StahlProfil UW 50 is the horizontal base and head guide track for CW 50 vertical studs in standard 75mm/100mm drywall partitions.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Must be fastened to structural floors and ceilings using hammer-set metal anchors at max 800mm centers. Apply self-adhesive acoustic foam sealing tape to the back of the track before fastening to prevent flanking noise.

products.name: StahlProfil UW 75 Floor & Ceiling Track (3.0m)
products.description: 75mm U-track for floor and ceiling perimeter anchoring of CW 75 partition walls.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: StahlProfil UW 75 is the perimeter anchoring track for CW 75 partitions, creating the top and bottom structural connection.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Fix at 800mm intervals using approved fasteners. Apply 75mm acoustic foam tape beneath track.

products.name: StahlProfil Heavy Structural UA 75 Doorframe (2.0mm)
products.description: 2.0mm heavy-gauge structural profile for framing commercial door portals and carrying heavy fire doors up to 100kg.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: StahlProfil UA 75 (2.0mm heavy gauge) is a heavy structural jamb stud engineered for door openings, sanitary wall fixtures, and free-standing partition ends.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Supports door leaf weights up to 100 kg. Moment of inertia: 28.5 cm⁴. Yield strength: 320 MPa.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Must be connected to structural slabs at top and bottom using heavy-duty UA connecting angle brackets with M8 bolts. Do not use standard drywall screws on UA studs; use self-drilling TB screws.

products.name: DecoupleSpring Resilient Sound Channel (3.0m)
products.description: Flexible single-leg resilient sound isolation channel that mechanically decouples plasterboards from structural studs.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: DecoupleSpring Resilient Channel (RC1 Profile) is a spring-steel decoupling rail mounted horizontally across metal or timber studs to isolate sound transmission.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Increases weighted sound reduction index Rw by +5 to +8 dB by breaking the rigid mechanical bridge between wall studs and drywall facing.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Mount horizontally at 400mm or 600mm centers with the mounting flange pointing downward. Drywall screws must penetrate the channel face only and NEVER touch the underlying studs (which would short-circuit acoustic decoupling).

products.name: PlasterMaster Unifill High-Adhesion Joint Compound (25kg)
products.description: Alpha-hemihydrate gypsum joint filler enriched with organic adhesion polymers, enabling crack-free jointing without joint tape.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: PlasterMaster Unifill 25kg (EN 13963 Type 4B) is a high-strength polymer-modified alpha-gypsum joint filler designed for filling board seams and covering screw heads.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Compressive strength: 8.5 N/mm². Provides high adhesion on rounded tapered HRAK board edges without requiring joint reinforcement tape. Working pot life: 45 minutes.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Mix with clean cold water (approx. 5 liters per 10kg powder). Do not re-temper set compound with additional water.

products.name: PlasterMaster VelvetSkim Ready-To-Use Paste (20kg)
products.description: Pre-mixed vinyl-copolymer finishing skim paste for rolling or spraying onto drywall to achieve Q4 glass-smooth surfaces.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: VelvetSkim 20kg is a ready-to-use air-drying finishing skim formulated with fine calcium carbonate and vinyl binder to produce Q4 glass-smooth wall surfaces.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Maximum grain size is under 35 microns. Sands effortlessly without clumping or dusting. Zero VOC emissions (<0.8 g/L).
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Apply in thin coats up to 2mm thickness. Substrate must be fully primed and cured prior to skimming.

products.name: AcoustiMastic Non-Hardening Flanking Caulk (310ml)
products.description: Permanently plastic synthetic polymer caulk engineered to seal perimeter drywall joints without drying out or cracking.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: AcoustiMastic 310ml is a permanently plastic acoustic sealant engineered to seal perimeter gaps between drywall framing and surrounding masonry or concrete.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Retains 98% elasticity for over 30 years without shrinkage or embrittlement, stopping airborne acoustic leaks.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Apply a continuous 6mm–10mm bead along all perimeter edges before installing baseboards.

products.name: ProFix Drywall Screws Fine-Thread 3.5x25mm (1000pcs)
products.description: Hardened carbon steel bugle head drywall screws with phosphate coating and needle point for fixing plasterboard to 0.7mm steel studs.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: ProFix TN 25mm fine-thread screws are precision drywall fasteners designed for fixing single-layer 12.5mm plasterboard to light-gauge metal studs up to 0.7mm.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Trumpet-shaped bugle head countersinks smoothly beneath the board paper surface without tearing the outer liner.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Drive with a drywall screwdriver fitted with a depth-setting nose cone. Space screws at max 250mm intervals along vertical studs.

products.name: ProFix Self-Drilling Tek Screws 3.5x35mm (1000pcs)
products.description: Self-drilling point screws engineered to drill through heavy structural steel profiles up to 2.25mm thick without pilot holes.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: ProFix TB 35mm self-drilling screws feature an integrated drill bit tip that bores through heavy 2.0mm structural UA doorframe studs in under 2 seconds without pre-drilling.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Minimum embedment through steel is 3 full exposed thread pitches.

products.name: AcoustiGasket Polyethylene Foam Track Tape 75mm (30m)
products.description: Closed-cell physically cross-linked PE foam tape with synthetic rubber adhesive for decoupling perimeter metal tracks.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: AcoustiGasket 75mm (30m roll) is a resilient cross-linked foam strip applied to the underside of UW 75 floor and ceiling tracks.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Seals against structural vibration transmission and airborne smoke leakage across partition perimeters.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Clean steel track free of oil and dust before applying adhesive foam tape.

products.name: ProFix Hammer-Drive Ceiling Wedge Anchor 6x40mm (100pcs)
products.description: All-steel fireproof expansion wedge anchor designed for structural overhead suspension of acoustic ceiling hangers in cracked concrete.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: ProFix Ceiling Wedge Anchor 6x40mm is an all-steel expansion anchor engineered for structural overhead fixing of suspended ceiling grids into cracked and uncracked concrete.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: ETA Option 1 approved for overhead tensile loads. Fire resistance rating R120.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Drill 6mm hole to 40mm depth, insert anchor through hanger bracket, and drive flush with a hammer.

products.name: PyroWrap Intumescent Pipe Fire Collar 110mm
products.description: Galvanized steel casing containing multi-layer expanding graphite intumescent material to crush combustible plastic pipes during a fire.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: PyroWrap Fire Collar 110mm is a passive fire protection device that mounts around combustible plastic drainage and soil pipes penetrating fire-rated drywall partitions.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: When temperatures reach 180°C, the high-pressure intumescent graphite core expands up to 25 times its original volume, crushing and sealing the melting plastic pipe to maintain an EI 120 fire barrier.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Must be secured to both sides of the drywall partition using M6 steel hollow wall expansion anchors.

products.name: PyroSafe Intumescent FireStop Mastic (310ml)
products.description: High-expansion intumescent acrylic sealant designed to seal pipe/cable penetrations and perimeter joints in fire barriers.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: PyroSafe Intumescent FireStop Mastic 310ml is an acrylic sealant engineered for sealing cable bundles, conduits, and linear joint gaps in fire partitions.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Expands over 400% when exposed to temperatures exceeding 140°C, forming a hard carbonaceous insulating barrier that prevents fire and toxic smoke passage for up to 120 minutes.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Ensure joint gap is backed with non-combustible stone wool before applying mastic. Smooth with a damp trowel.

products.name: PyroBlock Reusable Intumescent Fire Pillows
products.description: Flexible intumescent cushion bags filled with heat-reactive mineral fibers for temporary or re-penetrable cable tray openings in server rooms.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: PyroBlock Fire Pillows provide re-enterable fire barriers in server rooms, telecom hubs, and cable shafts where new wiring is regularly pulled.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Interlock pillows tightly in a brick-bond pattern around cable trays.

products.name: NordicShield WeatherGuard Exterior Sheathing 12.5mm
products.description: External gypsum sheathing board with water-repellent glass mat facing for ventilated rainscreen facades and steel frame external walls.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: NordicShield WeatherGuard 12.5mm (EN 15283-1) is a specialized external gypsum sheathing panel wrapped in hydrophobic non-woven glass mat facing for building envelope weatherization.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Withstands 12 months direct UV solar and rain exposure before facade cladding is hung. Rated Euroclass A1 non-combustible. Highly breathable (22 Perms) to permit internal structure drying.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Fasten onto light gauge steel framing or timber studs using weather-resistant coated exterior screws. Seal all vertical and horizontal board seams with UV-stable facade joint tape.

products.name: VaporShield Breathable Facade Membrane (50m)
products.description: Multi-layer monolithic polypropylene vapor-permeable membrane engineered to block wind-driven rain while allowing interior vapor escape.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: VaporShield Breathable Membrane is an external weather-barrier membrane designed for ventilated rainscreen claddings.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Water column resistance W1 prevents wind-driven rain infiltration. Sd value of 0.02m ensures building envelope breathability.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Overlap seams by minimum 100mm and bond using integrated acrylic adhesive strips.

products.name: SonorDecouple Cork-Rubber Impact Mat 8mm
products.description: High-density composite matrix of recycled tire granulate and natural cork designed for floating screed floor impact decoupling.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: SonorDecouple 8mm is an acoustic impact underlayment composed of selected recycled rubber polymers and cork granulate bound with polyurethane elastomer.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Reduces footstep impact sound transmission across concrete floor slabs by Delta Lw = 28 dB according to EN ISO 10140-3.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Lay edge-to-edge on flat structural subfloors. Seal all butt joints with waterproof tape before pouring liquid or cementitious screeds to avoid acoustic bridges.

products.name: AcoustiEdge Perimeter Foam Flanking Strip (25m)
products.description: L-shaped polyethylene perimeter expansion strip with integrated foil apron to isolate floating screeds from perimeter walls.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: AcoustiEdge Perimeter Strip prevents acoustic flanking by mechanically isolating floating screed slabs from perimeter drywall studs and walls.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Fix along all wall bases before screed pour. Trim excess foam flush with finished floor level only after tiling is completed.

products.name: Knauf Standard GKB Plasterboard 12.5mm
products.description: Ivory paper-faced gypsum plasterboard for internal partition walls and suspended ceiling grids.

data.rag_chunk:

TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Heavy gauge casing directs expansive crushing force inward on large diameter pipes.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Anchor on both sides of fire barrier.

products.name: PyroBoard Ablative Coated Mineral Wool Batt 50mm
products.description: High-density stone wool slab pre-coated with elastomeric fire-stopping ablative mastic.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: PyroBoard Ablative Coated Mineral Wool Batt 50mm (EN 1366-3, EN 13501-2) manufactured by Rockwool International A/S. High-density stone wool slab pre-coated with elastomeric fire-stopping ablative mastic. Sealing large multi-service cable and duct openings in fire-rated drywall walls.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Ablative coating releases water vapor under heat and forms an elastomeric fire and smoke seal.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Friction-fit into wall aperture and butter all perimeter joints with firestop mastic.

products.name: PyroWrap Flexible Fire Damper Duct Wrap 10mm
products.description: Flexible high-temperature insulation wrap for fire-stopping ventilation duct penetrations.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: PyroWrap Flexible Fire Damper Duct Wrap 10mm (EN 1366-1, EN 1366-3) manufactured by Hilti Corporation. Flexible high-temperature insulation wrap for fire-stopping ventilation duct penetrations. Protecting steel ventilation ductwork where it passes through fire compartment walls.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Prevents thermal conduction through duct walls and stops fire spreading to adjoining zones.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Wrap around duct for minimum 500mm on each side of partition and strap with stainless steel bands.

products.name: NordicShield WeatherGuard Exterior Sheathing 15mm
products.description: Heavy 15mm external gypsum sheathing board with water-repellent glass mat facing for tall rainscreen facades.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: NordicShield WeatherGuard Exterior Sheathing 15mm (EN 15283-1 (Type GM-F-H1-I), EN 13501-1) manufactured by NordicShield Gypsum AB. Heavy 15mm external gypsum sheathing board with water-repellent glass mat facing for tall rainscreen facades. External wind and weather barrier on light steel frame facade systems.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Withstands 12 months direct UV and rain exposure prior to external cladding installation.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Fasten with exterior coated screws. Seal joints with UV facade tape.

products.name: CemArmor Exterior Facade Rainscreen Backer 12.5mm
products.description: Weatherproof exterior cement board designed as a direct render carrier or rainscreen backing board.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: CemArmor Exterior Facade Rainscreen Backer 12.5mm (EN 12467, ETA-07/0173) manufactured by CemArmor Construction Elements. Weatherproof exterior cement board designed as a direct render carrier or rainscreen backing board. Applied as external backing board for ventilated rainscreen claddings and exterior render.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Impervious to frost, continuous rain, and rot. Rated Euroclass A1 non-combustible.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Fix onto aluminum or galvanized steel facade sub-constructions.

products.name: VaporShield UV Facade Joint Sealing Tape 60mm (25m)
products.description: UV-resistant polyolefin tape with high-tack acrylic adhesive for sealing exterior sheathing joints.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: VaporShield UV Facade Joint Sealing Tape 60mm (25m) (EN 13859-2) manufactured by IsoThermal Engineering S.A.. UV-resistant polyolefin tape with high-tack acrylic adhesive for sealing exterior sheathing joints. Sealing vertical and horizontal seams between exterior gypsum and cement facade boards.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Permanently airtight and windtight barrier resistant to temperature extremes (-40°C to +100°C).
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Apply to clean, dry board surfaces and press firmly with silicone seam roller.

products.name: ClimaControl Variable Vapor Retarder Membrane (50m)
products.description: Intelligent humidity-variable polyamide vapor check membrane for moisture-safe roof and wall cavities.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: ClimaControl Variable Vapor Retarder Membrane (50m) (EN 13984, DIN 4108-7) manufactured by ProClima Systems GmbH. Intelligent humidity-variable polyamide vapor check membrane for moisture-safe roof and wall cavities. Installed on the warm interior side of external insulated walls and pitched roofs.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Blocks winter vapor migration into insulation while opening in summer to allow rapid drying.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Overlap seams by 100mm and seal with airtight membrane tape.

products.name: AluVent Facade Base Ventilation Profile (2.5m)
products.description: Perforated aluminum base profile that allows cavity airflow while blocking rodents and insects.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: AluVent Facade Base Ventilation Profile (2.5m) (DIN 18516-1) manufactured by StahlProfil Metal Framing GmbH. Perforated aluminum base profile that allows cavity airflow while blocking rodents and insects. Installed at the bottom edge of ventilated rainscreen facade cavities.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Ensures code-required 200 cm²/m continuous airflow while preventing rodent ingress.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Fix to base wall framing with stainless steel fasteners.

products.name: Knauf Aquapanel Outdoor Cement Board 12.5mm
products.description: Exterior Portland cement board for ventilated rainscreens and exterior direct-applied render systems.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: Knauf Aquapanel Outdoor Cement Board 12.5mm (EN 12467, ETA-07/0173) manufactured by Knauf Aquapanel GmbH. Exterior Portland cement board for ventilated rainscreens and exterior direct-applied render systems. Exterior wall linings, soffits, and curved exterior facade canopies.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Withstands extreme weather, freezing cycles, and driving rain without warping.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Fasten to exterior framing with Aquapanel Maxi Outdoor screws.

products.name: CompriBand Expanding Weatherproof Joint Foam 20/4 (8m)
products.description: Pre-compressed polyurethane expanding foam tape for driving-rainproof window perimeter joints.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: CompriBand Expanding Weatherproof Joint Foam 20/4 (8m) (DIN 18542 BG1, EN 1027) manufactured by Tremco illbruck GmbH. Pre-compressed polyurethane expanding foam tape for driving-rainproof window perimeter joints. Sealing external gaps between window frames and exterior building envelope walls.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Expands into joint to create a 600 Pa driving-rainproof yet vapor-permeable seal.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Adhere to window frame exterior before mounting window into structural opening.

products.name: AluFlash Pre-Formed Facade Drip Flashing 2.5m
products.description: Aluminum drip edge profile to shed rainwater away from window headers and cladding joints.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: AluFlash Pre-Formed Facade Drip Flashing 2.5m (DIN 18516) manufactured by StahlProfil Metal Framing GmbH. Aluminum drip edge profile to shed rainwater away from window headers and cladding joints. Installed above external windows and horizontal cladding joints to direct rainwater away.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Prevents rainwater runoff from entering ventilation cavities.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Fasten with stainless steel screws.

products.name: ThermoShield Reflective Breathable Facade Membrane (50m)
products.description: Breathable weather barrier with low-emissivity aluminum coating that reflects radiant solar heat.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: ThermoShield Reflective Breathable Facade Membrane (50m) (EN 13859-2) manufactured by IsoThermal Engineering S.A.. Breathable weather barrier with low-emissivity aluminum coating that reflects radiant solar heat. Applied behind open-joint rainscreen claddings and external timber sidings.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Reflects 95% of radiant heat to lower indoor cooling demands in summer.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Tape all overlaps with metallic breathable tape.

products.name: ProClima ORCON Multi-Surface Airtight Sealant 600ml
products.description: Solvent-free high-elasticity adhesive paste for bonding vapor retarder membranes to rough concrete.

data.rag_chunk:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW: ProClima ORCON Multi-Surface Airtight Sealant 600ml (DIN 4108-7, EN 12207) manufactured by ProClima Systems GmbH. Solvent-free high-elasticity adhesive paste for bonding vapor retarder membranes to rough concrete. Bonding airtight vapor membranes to rough masonry, timber, and concrete floor slabs.
TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE: Maintains airtight bond for over 100 years without drying out or peeling.
INSTALLATION CONSTRAINTS: Apply 8mm bead without pressing flat.
